speaker: john_shakespeare
text: The door is shut, the board is full, and the church air is on your sleeves. How went the pulpit?

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Twice in fourteen months the Lord has laid His hand on this town.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: You turn God's barley into drink, and you steep it on the Sabbath, and you dry it on the Sabbath.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: And you call that your living.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: She has his hands too. Flat, like a man counting on a cushion.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: He said fourteen twice. She has given you one of them.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: One is the sermon. The cushion is not in it.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: If the Lord meant the maltsters He has a poor aim.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: He's unroofed a wheelwright, two weavers and a widow, and left every great malt-loft in the High Street dry as a bone.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: John.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The meat is cut. The sermon can sit down with it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the whole of what he said. I have not improved him.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: A player brings his sermon home in a girl's mouth. I have had worse messengers.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Thursday we show you the row. We said so. Not today.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Thursday, after the market. The chimney is still standing, and the weeds are already in it.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Twenty houses and barns. Nobody was hurt. That was yesterday's count, and it is still the count.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: You will not take them up the row today. Thursday is what they asked.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thursday, then. I have not promised Master Quiney his shop.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Quiney and his town. Let the town wait until a man has his boots on. He may come here on Tuesday and talk to a table.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The boots will not go on this morning's feet. He can hear a town from a chair, and tomorrow he can hear a list.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The nail is still mine. Thursday can look at the row and not at the nail.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I can do the widow after supper, if anyone wants the hens.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Not at table. The widow was Saturday. The vicar is done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The vicar is done. Your grandfather has answered him.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Two weavers, a wheelwright and a widow. If that is the aim, it wants a better eye.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Master Quiney had Will by the hand in the porch. The hand came away. That is the whole of the shop.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Eat. The barley in this loaf was in the house before he spoke.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am eating. I have no answer that would survive his porch.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Keep it. A porch is where another man's paper lives.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: The loaf, Joan. The pulpit has had its name.
